changes: No changes to content; added a note that the colophon has two text-end statements (Karmabalyarcanavidhi and Karmacakroddhāravidhi) and that the catalogue's Scribe and Date of Copying fields are empty.

notes: The colophon names no person, date or place. It has two text-end statements: 'karmmabalyārvva(!)vidhiḥ' (read: karmabalyarcanavidhi) and, from fol. 54v4, an added 'karmacakroddhāravidhi' (written 'karmmacakrodhāravidhiḥ'). The cataloguer's quotation leaves out part of the text (… ▒ ▒ ▒ …). The catalogue's Scribe and Date of Copying fields are empty.
